security.invariant: Matrix events are normalized before capability and presentation code consumes them.
Credentials, secret material, message bodies, and precise location are absent from diagnostics.
security.enforcement: Typed failure metadata and hostile-adapter tests

security.invariant: Matrix SDK imports remain inside approved Matrix adapters and pure Matrix modeling utilities.
security.enforcement: ESLint import boundaries and architecture dependency checks

security.invariant: Electron IPC is versioned, sender-validated, and capability-scoped.
security.enforcement: Host adapter contract and IPC security tests

security.invariant: Sensitive preferences declare storage and export restrictions.
security.enforcement: Preference catalog validation and export-schema guards
